settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Lay the 36“ x 72” mattress completely flat on a treatment table, ensuring no folds or overlapping sections exist in the internal heating grids.
Connect the system to a certified power outlet, set the built-in automatic countdown timer, and turn on the control interface.
Adjust the heat settings for each of the 3 separate zones independently, tailoring the thermal output to match the specific needs of the scheduled skincare service.
Set the exact temperature parameter within the safe, adjustable professional range of 30°C to 60°C (86°F to 140°F).
Turn off the power controls between treatment sessions, let the surface cool down entirely, and sanitize the outer waterproof cover before the next appointment.
Do not operate the unit while folded, bunched, or heavily creased, as irregular compression can cause hot spots and stress the internal thermal elements.
While the external treatment layer is entirely waterproof, do not submerge the power cables, control box, or terminal connectors in liquids.
Visually inspect the surface cover and wiring connectors routinely for signs of wear; use only manufacturer-authorized parts for upkeep.
